title: cde
description: A Common Data Element: a standardized, reusable data-element definition (NLM/ISO-11179 aligned). One record per CDE. Attach to a model property via x-pennsieve-cde. List-shaped fields are native arrays here; the catalog publisher flattens them to the dashboard's pipe-joined columns on export.

cde_key.description: The CDE's identity: an importer-computed canonical dedup key (nlm_identifier -> dec_identifier -> 'name:' + normalized cde_name). Key property => deterministic record ID + idempotent re-import. Referenced by cde_classification.cde_key, cde_bundle_tier.cde_key, and bundle.member_cde_keys.

persistent_id.description: Stable, resolvable public identifier (PURL/tinyId) for FAIR citation. Assigned on first publish; stable across re-publishes.

version.description: The CDE's catalog-side version (caDSR (publicId, version) practice) — a monotonic integer bumped on curation, and what x-pennsieve-cde bindings pin. NOT the catalog release version, and NOT the upstream source version (see source_version).

source_version.description: The upstream source's own version string, captured verbatim for provenance (e.g. NLM/caDSR '3.1'). Distinct from `version` (our integer that bindings pin); lets a re-sync detect when the upstream element actually changed.

copyright_status.description: Upstream copyright / redistribution status (NLM `copyrightStatus`, e.g. 'Public domain, free to use'). Gates whether this element's permissible values are license-restricted (SNOMED/LOINC-derived values are withheld upstream and must not be published); a curation/licensing signal (FAIR R1.1).

registration_status.description: NLM/ISO-11179 administered-item lifecycle. Retired CDEs remain published; Drafts are published (labeled).

nih_endorsed.description: NIH-Endorsed governance flag (NLM `nihEndorsed`): the NIH CDE Governance Committee has endorsed this element. Same flag as form.nih_endorsed / bundle.nih_endorsed.

managed_by.description: Integration-merge ownership of this canonical record: a source_key (import-owned — the integration import may overwrite it from that source per ranked priority) or 'curator' (hand-edited — the integration import must NEVER overwrite it: the no-clobber rule). Unset/null is treated as import-owned. Only meaningful in the canonical catalog dataset; source datasets leave it unset.

cde_name.description: Human-readable CDE name — a unique, unambiguous label distinguishing this CDE from others (e.g. 'Head circumference measurement').

variable_name.description: The machine/form variable name a data collector should use for this CDE in a form or dataset (NINDS `suggestedName`, e.g. 'DataCollDateTime'; the NIH template's project variable name). Short, CamelCase/token-style, source-provided — distinct from the human-readable `cde_name`. NULL for sources that don't supply one.

cde_type.description: The NIH CDE 'CDE Type' (NIH CDE Repository Guide): NULL/absent for an ordinary individual CDE; 'Composite' when the CDE is calculated/combined/concatenated from other CDEs (e.g. BMI, blood pressure — see `calculation_formula` / `concatenation_rule`); 'Bundled Set of Questions' when the CDE is a member of an indivisible bundle (a validated instrument like PHQ/AUDIT). Bundle membership itself is the cde -> bundle PART_OF edge; this only records the CDE's role.

concatenation_rule.description: For a Composite CDE whose value is concatenated from other CDEs (NIH 'Rules to Concatenate'): the rule combining the parts (e.g. '[First_name] [Middle_Initial] [Last_name]'). NULL otherwise.

calculation_formula.description: For a Composite CDE whose value is calculated from other CDEs (NIH 'Formula to Calculate'; NLM `derivationRules`): the formula (e.g. 'BMI = (weight_lbs / height_in^2) * 703'). NULL otherwise.

additional_instructions.description: Additional instructions for using this CDE (NIH 'Additional Instructions for CDE Use'). NULL when none.

input_restrictions.description: Data-collection input restriction: the input type (check box / radio button / free text) and/or a content rule (regular expression, length/format). Free string. NULL when none.

cde_definition.description: A subject-matter-expert textual definition describing the CDE in detail (e.g. 'Date of interview or visit').

cde_data_type.description: The type of data collected for this CDE (NIH CDE Repository data-type list).

preferred_question_text.description: The preferred text to use on a case report form, questionnaire, or measure to standardize how the data are collected.

cde_source.description: Display label of the originating catalog, e.g. NLM CDE Repository (matches provenance.provenance_name of the record it is SOURCED_FROM). Not the steward: see steward_org.

steward_org.description: Upstream registration authority / steward (caDSR, NINDS, NHLBI). Distinct from the Pennsieve importer identity, which is carried by record provenance_id/SOURCED_FROM.

permissible_values.description: Enumerated value domain (for cde_data_type = 'Value List'). Native array of objects; publisher flattens to pv_codes|pv_labels|pv_definitions|pv_code_systems|pv_concept_identifiers|pv_terminology_sources (positional).

unit_iri.description: Resolved UCUM/QUDT IRI snapshot for the unit.

measurement_method.description: LOINC-style axis: how measured (distinguishes 'glucose by method A' vs 'by method B').

cde_origin.description: How the value originates (source-specific vocab, e.g. COLLECTED / CALCULATION / STANDALONE). Free string — not hard-enumerated, since sources vary.

population.description: Age group / population this CDE applies to (e.g. 'Adult', 'Pediatric', 'All'). An applicability facet — NINDS often issues population-specific CDEs rather than varying a tier by population.

references.description: Published evidence on the validity/reliability of this CDE in target populations (DOIs / PubMed IDs / stable identifiers). Same shape as bundle.references (required for bundles, optional for CDEs).

nlm_identifier.description: Upstream stable id (NLM tinyId / NINDS catalog id) — a cde_key input.

dec_identifier.description: caDSR Data Element Concept id(s) — a cde_key input. The normalized concept link is also expressed as a REPRESENTS relationship to a concept record.

other_identifiers.description: Cross-walks to other registries. Native array; publisher flattens to pipe-joined 'LABEL:VALUE'.

nlm_view_url.description: Canonical NLM CDE Repository view page for this CDE (keyed by tinyId).

xrefs.description: Cross-reference crosswalk to source registries (NLM tinyId, NINDS code, caDSR DEC id, ...), derived from the id fields at import. This published crosswalk lets consumers pivot from the minted persistent_id to a source id (keeping the internal id non-lock-in). 'match' is 'carried' (ingested with the record) or 'exact' (a curator-asserted equivalence).
